scope: Canonical serviced PowerShell compatibility-host admission through the existing SAPI5Engine

canonical_sources.contract: Actual Windows directory; exact architecture-specific System32/SysWOW64 host; only the admitted system host receives the servicing hardlink exception.
SAPI provider obtains its process host through that narrow admission.
Exact serviced host permitted, foreign/wrong-architecture/hardlink alias refused. Other production contracts remain independently mapped.

changes: Only compatibility SAPI host selection moves from an environment-derived arbitrary local executable to the exact actual Windows-directory host.
GetSystemWindowsDirectoryW selects the shared OS directory even where GetWindowsDirectoryW could return a per-user Terminal Services directory. No environment fallback.
Explicit architecture is typed before OS lookup. sapi5 maps to System32; sapi5-32 maps to SysWOW64. Existing saved voice identifiers and cache serialization remain unchanged.
Every compatibility request rechecks the exact host path and current local path/link/reparse rules after cooperative cancellation and before the existing owned process runner.
Default native discovery stays passive for unselected 32-bit voices. Explicit saved selection constructs the same current compatibility adapter without a second process owner.
NativeSAPI5Engine, its fixed COM worker/PCM rate/cache fields, the existing process owner, and general local model/FFmpeg asset admission are unchanged.
Three existing synthetic protocol fixture modules now explicitly patch only the compatibility host seam. The existing actual installed Windows SAPI test remains unpatched.
policy_distinctions: The canonical general speech._io.local_file blanket hardlink prohibition is not copied into current general model_manifest.local_path, audio.engines._binary or audio.jobs.regular_file. Their existing verified-input and asset policies remain separate and unchanged.
The three added native checks inspect actual system host paths and admission without executing PowerShell, enumerating a 32-bit voice registry, or qualifying 32-bit synthesis.
The supported Windows qualification is the existing 64-bit installed application/runner. No 32-bit application bundle, alternative Windows layout, voice quality, model or physical playback claim.
new_native_labels: actual compatibility hosts use the shared Windows directory and distinct architectures
spoofed SystemRoot cannot redirect selected saved compatibility voice
wrong-architecture compatibility host is refused before any process
main_workflow_owner: Root composes only the new 34-case selector/Counter and the three native labels; no frozen workflow refs are changed by this component.
